_meta.description: Canonical Opta F24 type_id and qualifier_id reference for the panna ecosystem. Human-readable version: OPTA_REFERENCE.md in this same repo — read that first, this is its machine-readable companion.
_meta.rule: Nothing goes in here without a 'source' field citing either production code or an empirical cross-reference method. Never add a guessed value.

type_id.source: R/spadl_conversion.R OPTA_TYPE_NAMES — corpus-validated, byte-verified against inthegame-blog's scripts/opta-event-types.json copy on 2026-07-16

deliberately_omitted.reason: Unknown per spadl_conversion.R's own header comment — not in any public F24 reference. Consumers should fall through to a raw-code display fallback for these, never guess a label.

82.source: spadl_conversion.R:111 comment — flags a defender-blocked type-15 shot

15.source: parse_opta_qualifiers; re-confirmed empirically 2026-07-16 (posRate 0.53 vs negRate 0.0002 on shot events split by attHdTotal ground truth)

140.source: spadl_conversion.R + inthegame-blog worker, used throughout for pass/shot end coordinates

31.meaning: Yellow card (base flag — present on every card event: plain yellow, second yellow, and straight red alike, so not a useful discriminator alone)
31.source: worker/src/index.js card handling; re-confirmed empirically 2026-07-16 (100% on all three of redCard/secondYellow/plain-yellow groups, n=398 total)

32.meaning: Second yellow (i.e. this dismissal was via two yellows, not a straight red)
32.source: Empirical, 2026-07-16: 100% of 41 secondYellow-positive players carry it on their type-17 card event, 0% of 265 plain-yellow players.

33.meaning: Red card — but only catches straight reds, NOT second-yellow reds
33.confidence: partial — 55.4% of 92 redCard-positive players carry it (the rest are the second-yellow subset, correctly flagged by q32 instead)

14.meaning: Last man (last-ditch defensive action) — on type_id 7 (Tackle) = lastManTackle stat; on type_id 12 (Clearance) = clearanceOffLine stat. Qualifiers are event-type-scoped: this has NOTHING to do with cards, despite panna's wp_model.R/splint_creation.R checking q14 alongside q33 on type_id 17 (Card) events under the assumption it also flags red cards — empirically, q14 never appears on any card event at all (0% across 92 redCard + 41 secondYellow + 265 plain-yellow players checked). That existing check is very likely dead/wrong and misses second-yellow reds (should probably check q32 instead) — filed as panna#141, not fixed here (retraining/revalidation implications).
14.source: Empirical, 2026-07-16: events_World_Cup.parquet (2002-2026) vs opta_player_stats.parquet ground truth. Type-7: 100% of 60 sampled lastManTackle-positive players carry it, 0% of 74 negative. Type-12: 72% of 124 clearanceOffLine-positive players, 0% of 2814 plain-block negatives; independently corroborated by coordinates (clearance-off-line events average x=4.9, i.e. on the own goal line).

94.source: Empirical, 2026-07-16: restricted to type_id 10/74/69/12 events, 100% of 2281 outfielderBlock-positive players carry it vs 0.08% (6/7638) of negatives.

168.source: Empirical, 2026-07-16: on type_id 1/44 events, 100% of 60 sampled totalFlickOn-positive players vs 0% of 104 negative.

75.confidence: moderate — real ~12x lift, not a clean 100/0 split, attribution may need refinement before use
75.source: Empirical, 2026-07-16: on type_id 6 events, 57% of 3383 wonCorners-positive players vs 4.6% of 2805 negatives.

unconfirmed.six_yard_block: No qualifier found that discriminates sixYardBlock from a plain block (checked type_id 10/74/69/12, plus coordinates — six-yard-block events average x=13.6, statistically the same as plain blocks at x=13.8, unlike the cleanly-separated clearance-off-line events at x=4.9). Needs a different signal or wider search.
unconfirmed.foot_side: q15=Head is solid; left/right foot qualifier IDs are contested across sources in this ecosystem (36 vs 72 vs the old doc's unverified 73) and were not empirically re-checked this session.
unconfirmed.coordinate_qualifiers_55_56_102_103_230_: Previously asserted as start/end coordinate qualifiers in an older version of OPTA_REFERENCE.md; conflicts with the confirmed 140/141 end-coordinate qualifiers actually used by production code. Not re-verified — treat as unconfirmed, not disproven.
